turns.text:
ok wait boss can you make this sound better before my shift starts, opens at 6:15. msg to rick the market guy:

"hey rick!! jun here from lola's roll 🥢 hope your week's going great. just wanted to check where i am on the sunday waitlist at delgado park, no rush at all!! also the county told me fried shrimp lumpia doesnt count as cottage food so i gotta use a commissary and get a county health permit, which is fine, im on it lol. thanks man!"

Nice, this is already warm and easy to read. Here's a lightly tightened version:

"Hi Rick! This is Jun from Lola's Roll 🥢 Hope your week's going well. I wanted to check where I stand on the Sunday waitlist at Delgado Park, and whether a slot looks likely in the next few weeks.

Quick update: the county told me fried shrimp lumpia doesn't qualify as cottage food, so I'll be working out of a commissary and getting a county health permit instead. I'm handling that now and can send you details once it's sorted.

Thanks so much!
Jun"

I added a line asking about timing, since that's the thing you actually need to know. Want me to cut it shorter?

love it. ok actually the health permit part sounds more done than it is lol, the packet's just sitting on my table, ill get to it this weekend. can you make it say im working on it without saying i did stuff

Sure, here's the honest-but-confident version of that paragraph:

"Quick update: the county told me fried shrimp lumpia doesn't qualify as cottage food, so I'll be using a commissary and applying for a county health permit. I'm in the process of getting that together and will send you the details once it's in."

That says you're on it without claiming anything is submitted. If the packet is ready sooner, you can update him then.

perfect 🔥 next one. group text to paolo about prep. i keep softening it, this is the third version lol:

"yo paolo lol so um saturday prep maybe we can start earlier?? no pressure haha ur the boss of sleeping 😂 thurs-sat u close till 11 so i get it but we kinda need to roll before noon or we sell out nothing 🥢"

make it sound chill not annoyed

Here's a version that's friendly but clear, so it doesn't read as a joke or a complaint:

"Hey Paolo! Quick one about Saturday prep. I know you close Thursday through Saturday and get out around 11, so mornings are rough. But we need to start rolling before noon to have enough ready. Could we pick a start time that works for you, or split it so I do the early part and you jump in when you can? Let me know what's easiest 🥢"

It keeps your acknowledgment of his closing shifts, drops the "no pressure" and sleeping jokes, and gives him an actual question to answer. Want a shorter one?
short version pls, shift starts in 10

"Hey Paolo! I know you close Thu-Sat, so mornings are tough. Can we lock in a prep start time before noon on Saturdays? Tell me what works for you 🥢"

Good luck with the opening shift!
